name: title
text: Same person, four different scenes. Here's how to keep one character consistent across a whole AI video series.

name: presets
text: Start in the varg agent. Open presets, go to characters, and pick one. This one is called Woman in Red.

name: prompt
text: Then write the whole series in one message: the four scenes, and one rule. Keep her face, her haircut and her sweater exactly the same in every shot.

name: cost
text: You see an estimate before anything renders, and nothing runs until you approve it.

name: run
text: The agent turns the character into a keyframe for each scene, then animates every one with MiniMax H3.

name: done
text: When the render finishes, the whole series lands right in your project.

name: results
text: Cafe, canal, record shop, rooftop. Four places, and it's the same person in every one.

name: tip
text: The trick is to name what makes her recognizable, like the bob and the red sweater, and ask for it to stay the same. That's all I did here.

name: cta
text: Pick a character and make your own series at varg dot A I.
